name: Vadrik
description: A reclusive astronomancer and archmage of Nephalia who is called to Lambholt to deal with a killer and works with the inquisitor Rem Karolus.

timeline.summary: Vadrik arrives at Lambholt at night, called for help, and is nearly shot by a nervous guard.
timeline.quote: a crossbow bolt flew past his head and sunk halfway to its fletching into a nearby alder

timeline.summary: Vadrik meets the council of crones and mothers and the inquisitor Rem Karolus, who was hired by Dein Salvasi, and they agree to work together.
timeline.quote: "Then I suppose we'll be working together."

timeline.summary: Vadrik examines three bodies in a pasture, one a werewolf reverted on death, all pierced as if by arrows.
timeline.quote: Well, two dead people and one dead werewolf

timeline.summary: Vadrik casts a tracking spell with star dust and, annoyed at Rem calling him a hound, makes Rem's mouth vanish briefly.
timeline.quote: His mouth, more importantly, was gone, disappeared by Vadrik's magic.

timeline.summary: The two follow the tracks to an aspen grove where Old Stickfingers appears behind Vadrik.
timeline.quote: Old Stickfingers lived up to his name.

timeline.summary: Rem stabs Stickfingers and Vadrik blasts him with ice; Rem drives his blade through the creature's face and it vanishes.
timeline.quote: Rem stood up and drove his blade through the beast's chin, up through his face.

timeline.summary: In the morning Vadrik meets Ariosa, Arinos's daughter, and sets out to investigate the Salvasi manor.
At the Salvasi manor Vadrik and Rem find a broken door, an empty house, signs of violence and a message in ash, and Vadrik finds black goat fur.
timeline.quote: Instead of a warm welcome and food, the pair found a door broken open, hanging from one hinge.

timeline.summary: At Arinos's farm Vadrik finds a twig mobile and deduces that Arinos summoned Stickfingers to get rid of Salvasi.
timeline.quote: "Arinos summoned Stickfingers to dispose of Salvasi and save his farm," Vadrik said.

timeline.summary: Vadrik crushes the mobile with Stickfingers's blood on it, thinking this will unsummon him, and a keening comes from the alders.
timeline.quote: He then raised one boot and slammed it down, crushing the thing underfoot.

timeline.summary: The village bell tolls: Stickfingers is inside the walls, and Ariosa says that Vadrik and Rem set him free.
timeline.quote: "Just came from home," she said to Malynn, then she looked daggers at the pair of men. "They set him free."

timeline.summary: Malynn explains that Stickfingers is a hearth spirit of this place and cannot be sent away; Vadrik realizes he was summoned to protect, not to kill.
timeline.quote: "So he was summoned, not to kill, but to protect?"

timeline.summary: Vadrik works out that Arinos did not finish the summoning, so Stickfingers killed intruders on the old estate's land; Rem holds the monster back and Vadrik heals him.
timeline.quote: Killed Arinos as an intruder on his own land.

timeline.summary: Ariosa repairs the mobile and sings the binding, offering a goat; Stickfingers appears, accepts the goat and walks off peacefully as guardian of her home.
timeline.quote: Stickfingers barked, and the white goat ambled over to him.

timeline.summary: Vadrik declines Rem's offer to team up and rides home, but wonders why the second bed was made and why Ariosa survived unscathed.
timeline.quote: How odd it was that Ariosa had survived, unscathed.

pages_say.description: A reclusive astronomancer and archmage of Nephalia who is called to Lambholt to deal with a killer and works with the inquisitor Rem Karolus.
